rules.statement: The sale was ad quantitatem for an extent of 44 acres, and the defendants are liable to compensate the plaintiffs for the value of the remaining 5 acres.
rules.supporting_quote: "An. extent of A. 5 R. 3 P. 20 is outstanding, and the defendants are liable to compensate the plaintiffs for the value of that extent."

meta.parties: Theobald Et Al. v. Arambepola Et Al
